newsitem.title: USA: Democrats seen gaining some NYS Legislature seats.
newsitem.headline: Democrats seen gaining some NYS Legislature seats.

text.p: While Republicans still control the state Senate and Democrats still control the state Assembly, voters in New York State apparently pushed the Democrats into a few more seats in both chambers.
Before the election, Democrats controlled the Assembly 95 to 54, while Republicans controlled the Senate 37 to 24.
Election results are still being tallied, by reports give the Democrats a few more seats in each chmaber.
